summary: Frontend-only test of Rokad 'remember last Cash/Bank account + Mode'. All 16 checks PASS: (1) with localStorage cleared, a new entry defaults to 301 CASH IN HAND / Cash, V.No=1. (2) Saving a cash entry stores {cash_account_id, mode:'Cash'} in 'vyapari.rokad.lastUsed'. (3) Changing the account to 302 HDFC M M TRADERS. auto-sets Mode=Bank; switching to Cheque and saving stores {HDFC, Cheque}. (4) Reopening 'Nayi Entry' shows HDFC/Cheque, V.No auto-filled ('2'). (5) Same after a page reload. (6) The 'r' and 'p' shortcuts both open with HDFC/Cheque, and the Jama/Kharch type is set correctly. (7) Account filter wins: AXIS filter → AXIS/Bank (V.No 1); CASH filter → CASH/Cash; HDFC filter (same as last-used) → HDFC/Cheque. Clearing the filter brings back HDFC/Cheque. (8) Editing the cash entry shows CASH/Cash (its own values). Cancel → a new entry still shows HDFC/Cheque, so memory is not overwritten. (9) Saving the edit updates memory to {CASH, Cash} → a new entry shows CASH/Cash. QA entries deleted through the UI.

issues: Mode <select> has no data-testid (tests had to use nth select). Please add data-testid='select-mode'.

action_items: (Low) Add data-testid='select-mode' to the Mode select in RokadPanna.jsx (~line 716).
critical_code_review_comments: RokadPanna.jsx is 822 lines (>700); consider splitting the entry modal into its own component.
Pre-existing: the account list shows both '301 · CASH IN HAND' (party) and the legacy 'Cash IN Hand' (accounts collection), which could confuse users. Not related to this feature.
Behaviour note (OK): in a new form, changing the account resets the remembered Mode to the account's default, because modeTouched is false. This is expected.
seed_data_creation: No QA account created (already 7 cash/bank accounts). Two QA rokad entries (QA_LU_CASH ₹12, QA_LU_HDFC ₹11) created and deleted.
